dedupe_keys.name: wisegeorgia water information system water quantity and quality data maps and indicators of georgia

description: WiseGeorgia is the water information system of Georgia's Ministry of Environmental Protection and Agriculture, built with support of the EU Water Initiative Plus. The indicator page read on 2026-09-28 sits within menus for quantitative water data, water quality data, a glossary, the EUWI+ database, an interactive water map, static maps and a set of indicators. Indicator C1 on renewable freshwater resources states that Georgia averages about 51,000 million cubic metres of renewable freshwater a year, some 14,000 cubic metres per inhabitant, and offers a chart of the 1981 to 1991 series with a data download, sourced from the hydrometeorology department of the National Environmental Agency and the ministry. Coverage is Georgia. Access is free on the web; the page states no licence. Caveats: the page is in Georgian, the chart series shown is historical, and the other indicators and data sections were not opened. It supports water resource and capacity planning studies, such as comparing abstraction against renewable resources by basin. Related record: the Geostat 2024 census tables give household water supply facilities for Georgia.
